title: Close GF(2) BitMatrix gaps to M4RI
description:
Close GF(2) BitMatrix performance gaps to M4RI.

## Background

Post-PPC matmul improved substantially but remains about 0.42x M4RI at n=1024 and 0.31x at n=4096. One-level Strassen did not cross over through n=8192, so the next work must target M4RI-style table/cache scheduling and related GF(2) operations.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] GF(2) matmul target rows are within 1.5x of M4RI or faster.
- [hard] GF(2) echelon/rank rows required by the target matrix are measured and within threshold or have user-approved scope amendments.
- [hard] A final GF(2) parity report records raw numbers, ratios, and production dispatch policy.
